deployment_evidence.note: Verify each subsequent deployed batch again; this is not evidence of Instagram scheduling or publication.

quota_policy: Before each new schedule, reconcile all published feed posts/Reels/Stories and all queued posts, including manually created content, plus pending or uncertain reservations. Preserve monthly observations, avoid double counting, stop when coverage is unknown or projected monthly total exceeds 20. No upgrade.
publication_policy: User-authorised autonomous topic selection, scientific review, production and publishing. Require actual original-paper verification, deployed-media inspection, duplicate checks, source links and quota checks. Never claim link-in-bio until bio_link_confirmed. Never schedule the disabled deployment pilot.
